purpose: Operational rejection fixtures for candidate Hodge proof routes. A route passes only when every triggered fixture is discharged by an explicit theorem or construction.
claim_boundary: Rejecting a route proves neither the Hodge conjecture nor its negation. These fixtures prevent hidden algebraicity, coefficient, domain, and quantifier substitutions.

fixtures.name: coefficient_drift
fixtures.tempting_argument: Replace rational cycle classes by integral cycle classes.
fixtures.invalid_step: Infer integral representability from rational Hodge type.
fixtures.reject_scope: Any route that changes Q to Z without an independent restricted theorem.
fixtures.surviving_route: Keep CH^p(X) tensor Q and rational singular cohomology throughout.

fixtures.name: pp_type_to_rational
fixtures.tempting_argument: Treat every complex (p,p) class as a rational Hodge class.
fixtures.reject_scope: Dimension counts over C used as rational generation.
fixtures.surviving_route: Start with alpha in H^(2p)(X,Q) intersect H^(p,p)(X).

fixtures.name: divisor_extrapolation
fixtures.invalid_step: Replace CH^p by Picard data for p greater than 1.
fixtures.reject_scope: Any higher-codimension route with no algebraic push-pull bridge.
fixtures.surviving_route: Use divisors only for divisor-polynomial summands; construct exceptional classes separately.

fixtures.name: inverse_lefschetz_circularity
fixtures.tempting_argument: Use the cohomological inverse Lefschetz operator as an algebraic correspondence.
fixtures.silently_inserted_statement: Lefschetz standard conjecture for the selected class.
fixtures.reject_scope: Unproved algebraic star or inverse-Lefschetz correspondences.
fixtures.surviving_route: Use only independently algebraic correspondences, such as graphs of actual morphisms or endomorphisms.

fixtures.name: kunneth_projector_circularity
fixtures.tempting_argument: Decompose the diagonal with algebraic Kunneth projectors.
fixtures.invalid_step: Assume algebraicity of Hodge Kunneth components.
fixtures.silently_inserted_statement: The required standard-conjecture/Hodge consequence on a product.
fixtures.reject_scope: Motive decompositions whose projectors are only cohomological.
fixtures.surviving_route: Use explicit algebraic morphisms and cycles with independently verified classes.

fixtures.name: hodge_locus_substitution
fixtures.tempting_argument: Use algebraicity of a Hodge locus to conclude the Hodge class is algebraic.
fixtures.invalid_step: Confuse an algebraic parameter locus with a relative algebraic cycle.
fixtures.surviving_route: Construct a cycle or coherent sheaf whose class deforms under an explicit theorem.

fixtures.name: deformation_substitution
fixtures.tempting_argument: Transport algebraicity because a flat class stays Hodge.
fixtures.invalid_step: Replace flat cohomological transport by transport of algebraic cycles.
fixtures.silently_inserted_statement: Variational Hodge or an adequate semiregularity/relative-cycle theorem.
fixtures.reject_scope: Generic-to-special or special-to-generic algebraicity with no deformation theorem.
fixtures.surviving_route: Prove semiregularity or another explicit deformation theorem for the constructed algebraic object.

fixtures.name: numerical_period_substitution
fixtures.tempting_argument: Declare a high-precision period relation exact and algebraic.
fixtures.invalid_step: Promote floating-point recognition to rationality and cycle equality.
fixtures.silently_inserted_statement: Exact relation certification plus exhaustive cycle generation.
fixtures.reject_scope: Numerical period evidence used as theorem-grade algebraicity.
fixtures.surviving_route: Use exact symbolic identities only after an algebraic cycle construction is specified.

fixtures.name: tate_without_lifting
fixtures.tempting_argument: Prove a Tate statement after reduction and lift it to characteristic zero.
fixtures.invalid_step: Collapse specialization, comparison, field-of-definition, and cycle lifting into one arrow.
fixtures.silently_inserted_statement: A complete good-reduction and lifting theorem.
fixtures.surviving_route: Audit every comparison and lifting arrow separately or remain over C.

fixtures.name: topological_chern_substitution
fixtures.tempting_argument: Use topological K-theory or a formal Chern character decomposition as algebraic generation.
fixtures.invalid_step: Replace algebraic coherent sheaves/cycles by topological bundles.
fixtures.silently_inserted_statement: Algebraization of the relevant K-theory objects.
fixtures.reject_scope: Topological generation with no algebraic representative.
fixtures.surviving_route: Use coherent sheaves or derived coherent objects defined algebraically; their Chern classes are algebraic.

fixtures.name: abel_jacobi_completeness
fixtures.tempting_argument: Treat Abel-Jacobi control as a complete algebraicity detector.
fixtures.invalid_step: Infer existence of arbitrary cycle preimages from a partial invariant.
fixtures.reject_scope: General sufficiency claims from Abel-Jacobi vanishing/control.
fixtures.surviving_route: Use Abel-Jacobi only when a class-specific completeness theorem is proved.

fixtures.name: projective_to_kahler
fixtures.tempting_argument: Replace smooth projective by compact Kahler because Hodge decomposition remains available.
fixtures.invalid_step: Drop algebraic projectivity while retaining an algebraic-cycle conclusion.
fixtures.reject_scope: Kahler-only routes presented as the classical conjecture.
fixtures.surviving_route: Keep the selected target inside smooth projective algebraic varieties.

fixtures.name: absolute_or_motivated_substitution
fixtures.tempting_argument: Promote absolute or motivated Hodge status to algebraicity.
fixtures.invalid_step: Identify a stability/enlarged-correspondence notion with algebraic cycles.
fixtures.reject_scope: Terminological substitution for an actual cycle.
fixtures.surviving_route: Use absolute/motivated status only as auxiliary structure; construct algebraic cycles independently.

fixtures.name: generic_to_every_fiber
fixtures.tempting_argument: Prove a generic or very-general statement and extend it to all fibers.
fixtures.invalid_step: Ignore jumping Hodge ranks and additional special-fiber classes.
fixtures.silently_inserted_statement: A specialization theorem controlling every new Hodge class.
fixtures.reject_scope: Quantifier promotion from generic to every member of a family.
fixtures.surviving_route: State the generic-Hodge-ring locus explicitly, or prove a separate all-fibers theorem.

fixtures.name: effectivity_strengthening
fixtures.tempting_argument: Demand a single effective irreducible representative.
fixtures.invalid_step: Strengthen rational linear-combination generation to effectivity.
fixtures.reject_scope: False rejection of a valid rational cycle because subtraction or denominators occur.
fixtures.surviving_route: Permit finite rational combinations of codimension-p algebraic subvarieties.

HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3.geometric_domain: pass: polarized complex abelian varieties are smooth projective
HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3.rational_input: pass: target quantifies over rational Hodge classes
HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3.divisor_extrapolation: pass only for the divisor-generated summand; Weil summand has an independent construction obligation
HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3.projector_circularity: pass: route uses graphs of algebraic endomorphisms and Fourier-Mukai/coherent-sheaf constructions, not assumed algebraic projectors
HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3.hodge_locus_substitution: pass: no Hodge-locus theorem is used as a cycle construction
HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3.deformation_substitution: OPEN: the route requires an explicit semiregularity/deformation theorem; Hodge persistence alone is insufficient
HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3.generic_to_every_fiber: pass only because the target class is explicitly restricted to the generic Hodge-ring locus; no all-fibers claim is made
HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3.effectivity: pass: CH^4 tensor Q is the cycle domain
